last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription acne self-management topics. The final query set returned 148 unique PubMed PMIDs, 148 fetched article records, and 147 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 17314442, 26832428, 41470154, 17616769, 30229883, 31712293, 34981580, 26705462, 35426044, 29705755, 33651470, 7622270, and 25502610. Thirteen retained PubMed references were added across 13 new entries. New entries cover tea tree oil, kanuka honey, oral probiotics, low-glycemic diet, stress management, blue light, red light, pulsed-dye laser, microneedling for acne scars, chemical peels, hydrocolloid patches, facial cleansing, and acne education. The zinc topic was linked to existing entry zinc-acne-pos. Aloe vera, witch hazel, niacinamide, vitamin D, omega-3, dairy-free diet, Mediterranean diet, weight loss, exercise, sleep, mindfulness, yoga, CBT, acupuncture, photodynamic therapy, and moisturizer topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect. Five truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 49-person hydrocolloid comparison, 19-person laser trial, 43-person low-glycemic diet trial, 28-person red-light trial, and 30-person stress-management trial, including the prior thin-study backlog.
